title: GlucoPRISM: Protocol-Supervised Pretraining for Cross-Cohort Glucose Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2610.12528v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) foundation models encode each day as one vector that mixes who the person is, what happened that day and how the sensor measured it, so measurement differences travel with the representation into new cohorts. We ask whether pretraining can place the measurement component that harms transfer in known coordinates, so that deployment drops them with a fixed projection and no target data. GlucoPRISM supervises a GlucoFM backbone with response contracts, rules for how each part of the representation should change when only the day or only the sensor changes: a 64-dimensional Trait band should change with neither, a 48-dimensional State band only across days, and a 16-dimensional Sensor band should track the device. translated_title: GlucoPRISM：面向跨队列血糖迁移的协议监督预训练
translated_abstract: 连续血糖监测（CGM）基础模型将每一天编码为一个向量，该向量混合了这个人是谁、那天发生了什么以及传感器如何进行测量，因此测量差异会随表示一同进入新的队列。我们探究预训练能否将损害迁移能力的测量成分置于已知坐标中，使部署阶段无需目标数据、仅用固定投影即可将其去除。GlucoPRISM 通过“响应契约”来监督 GlucoFM 骨干网络，即规定仅改变日期或仅改变传感器时表示的各个部分应如何变化：64 维的特质带对两者均不应变化，48 维的状态带仅跨天变化，而 16 维的传感器带应跟踪设备。通过在配对的 Dexcom 与 Libre 记录上校准的合成传感器视图、不同日期的配对以及血糖摘要目标来提供这种监督，且无需任何临床标签。在十二个跨队列（实验中）……
tldr: GlucoPRISM 提出协议监督的预训练方法，将 CGM 表示划分为对日期和传感器均不变的特质带、仅随日期变化的状态带以及跟踪设备的传感器带，使部署时无需目标数据即可通过固定投影去除损害跨队列迁移的测量成分。
en_tdlr: GlucoPRISM introduces protocol-supervised pretraining that partitions CGM representations into a day- and sensor-invariant trait band, a day-varying state band, and a device-tracking sensor band, enabling deployment to remove transfer-harming measurement components with a fixed projection and no target data.
